A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''stormtrooper''' served on the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Anya Karu]]'' under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Aron Harcourt]] prior to [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]]. The [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] most likely [[Death/Legends|perished]] when the ''Anya Karu'' was sabotaged by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]], causing it to crash on a [[Unidentified planet (Anya Karu)|distant planet]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] encountered and shot the corpse of the stormtrooper when he searched the remains of the ''Anya Karu'' in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] after Harcourt, who had survived the crash, requested a [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecording]] left on the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] of his departed wife [[Janelle Harcourt]].
